description: ACCDB: session 1 creates P(ID PK) and C1..C4(ID PK, PID) and closes; session 2 appends R_One(P->C1), R_Two(P->C2), R_Three(P->C3), pauses 1500ms, deletes R_Two, appends R_Four(P->C4), pauses 1500ms, and closes. Keeps all pages at every step to observe parent .rB naming order, removal, and slot reuse.
